tat.title: New Lead Response Time (TAT)
tat.description: Make sure new leads get contacted quickly. If the assigned counsellor doesn't reach out in time, they'll be reminded. Choose how they're notified (email, WhatsApp, in-app) under <1>Settings → Automations</1>.

summary.withRemindersPart1: a new lead should be contacted within
summary.withRemindersPart3: before the deadline. If still untouched, the lead is flagged
summary.noRemindersPart1: a new lead should be contacted within
summary.noRemindersPart2: . If still untouched, the lead is flagged
summary.offhours: Leads that arrive outside working hours are due at {{time}} on the next working day.

responseWithin.label: Respond to a new lead within
responseWithin.hint: After this much time without contact, the lead is overdue.

earlyReminders.title: Early reminders (optional)
earlyReminders.description: Give the counsellor a heads-up before the deadline. Add more than one to remind them again as it gets closer.

offhours.label: Leads that arrive outside working hours
offhours.hint: Due at this time on the next working day.

followup.title: Follow-up Reminders (SLA)
followup.description: Keep counsellors following up. Once they've contacted a lead, they'll be reminded to follow up again within the time you set. The clock restarts every time they log a new activity (call, note, meeting).

within.label: Follow up again within
within.hint: Time allowed between contacts before the lead is flagged.

earlyReminder.label: Early reminder
earlyReminder.hint: Nudge the counsellor this long before the follow-up is due.

followup.summaryPart1: after a counsellor logs an activity on a lead, they have
followup.summaryPart2: to follow up again, with a nudge
followup.summaryPart3: before it's due. The timer restarts each time they act.

offhours.label: Activity logged outside working hours
offhours.hint: Follow-up due at this time on the next working day.

followup.summaryOffhours: If the last activity was outside working hours, the follow-up is due at {{time}} on the next working day.

notifyRoles.label: Notify which roles
notifyRoles.description: These roles are sent to your workflow so it can notify them. Pick the message and channel under Settings → Automations.
notifyRoles.noRolesFound: No roles found for this institute.

workingHours.title: Working hours
workingHours.description: TAT and follow-up deadlines follow your working hours. A clock that starts inside working hours runs for the time you set; one that starts outside them is due at a fixed time on the next working day.
workingHours.noDays: Pick at least one working day.
workingHours.endBeforeStart: Working hours must end after they start.
workingHours.timezoneNote: Times are in {{tz}} (set under Settings → Language).
